language.opening: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.
chapter: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.

However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families, that he is considered as the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.
“My dear Mr. Bennet,” said his lady to him one day, “have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?”
Mr. Bennet replied that he had not.
“But it is,” returned she; “for Mrs. Long has just been here, and she told me all about it.”
“Do not you want to know who has taken it?” cried his wife, impatiently.
“You want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it.”

“Why, my dear, you must know, Mrs. Long says that Netherfield is taken by a young man of large fortune from the north of England; that he came down on Monday in a chaise and four to see the place, and was so much delighted with it that he agreed with Mr. Morris immediately; that he is to take possession before Michaelmas, and some of his servants are to be in the house by the end of next week.”
“Oh, single, my dear, to be sure! A single man of large fortune; four or five thousand a year. What a fine thing for our girls!”

items.desc: Same-finger bigrams: consecutive keys on one finger (different keys).
items.name: SFB

items.desc: Same-finger skipgrams: two keys on one finger with any one symbol between (space too).
items.name: SFS

items.desc: Retired: same-finger distance per 100 bigrams, g(distance) × finger factor (profile `sfb`). Keystroke timing shows no distance effect beyond sfb.
items.name: Finger speed

items.desc: Same finger with 2–3 keys between, decayed per extra key (profile `sfb.skip_decay`).
items.name: Far SFS

items.desc: Retired: finger speed (sfb_distance) applied to skipgrams with one key between.
items.name: SFS distance

items.desc: Lateral stretch: index on a center-column key next to the middle finger.
items.name: LSB

items.desc: Adjacent fingers, same hand, two-row jump.
items.name: Scissors

items.desc: Adjacent fingers, same hand, one-row jump with the shorter finger on the upper row.
items.name: Half scissors

items.desc: Same hand, different fingers, moving toward the index finger.
items.name: Bigram rolls in

items.desc: Consecutive keys on the pinky and ring finger of one hand.
items.name: Pinky–ring pairs

items.desc: Vertical travel between consecutive same-hand keys, each measured from its finger's home key, per 100 bigrams.
items.name: Row jump

items.desc: Geometric stretch between same-hand fingers per 100 bigrams (Oxeylyzer 2); covers LSB, scissors, crossings.
items.name: Stretch

items.desc: Same-hand finger-pair movement cost per 100 bigrams (KLO table, finger-length scissor rule, ring coupling).
items.name: Movement

items.desc: Stretch (stretch) between keys 1 and 3 of a trigram per 100 skipgrams: disjoint LSB / scissors (Kühlmak).
items.name: Skip stretch

items.desc: Average key effort per keystroke: geometry base effort plus the profile's per-finger `row_offset`, plus layer key effort and Shift key effort per Shift press.
items.name: Effort

items.desc: RMS gap between finger loads and the profile's target loads.
items.name: Finger load error

items.desc: Root-sum-square of non-thumb finger shares; lowest when load is even.
items.name: Finger balance

items.desc: Highest non-thumb finger load as % of that finger's target load (profile `finger_target`).
items.name: Peak finger load

items.desc: Share of keystrokes on the left hand; scored as squared distance from 50%.
items.name: Left hand

items.desc: Share of keystrokes on the thumbs; scored as squared distance from the profile's `thumb_target`.
items.name: Thumb load

items.desc: Hand-model reach cost per keystroke: joint deviation from the natural curl, sideways splay and fingertip shortfall with the hand placed on the home keys (profile `hand`, default average).
items.name: Reach

items.desc: Hand-model press misalignment per keystroke: (angle / 45°)² between the fingertip's press direction and the keycap normal (fingers: the distal phalanx, within the finger's plane; thumbs: a push along the CMC→tip line).
items.name: Press angle

items.desc: Hand-model wrist cost per keystroke: ulnar/radial deviation, extension and forearm pronation of the resting hand (elbows from profile `hand.body`; split halves placed to suit the arm), plus the extra deviation of sideways reaches.
items.name: Wrist posture

items.desc: Hand-model thumb cost per keystroke: (distance off the thumb's natural arc / 10 mm)², the arc being the tip's path as the CMC sweeps its flexion range with the other joints at rest; 0 on finger keys.
items.name: Thumb arc fit

items.desc: Share of keystrokes on the home row.
items.name: Home row

items.desc: Share of keystrokes on the index stretch columns.
items.name: Center columns

items.desc: Consecutive keys on different hands.
items.name: Hand alternation

items.desc: Trigrams that alternate hands L-R-L / R-L-R (no same-finger skip).
items.name: Alternates

items.desc: Alternating trigrams whose first and third keys share a finger.
items.name: Alternate SFS

items.desc: Two same-hand keys rolling toward the thumb plus one other-hand key.
items.name: Rolls in

items.desc: Two same-hand keys rolling away from the thumb plus one other-hand key.
items.name: Rolls out

items.desc: Three same-hand keys in one direction.
items.name: One-hand rolls

items.desc: Three same-hand keys that change direction.
items.name: Redirects

items.desc: Redirects that do not use the index finger.
items.name: Bad redirects

items.desc: Same-finger trigrams: all three keys on one finger.
items.name: SFT

items.desc: Trigrams with a thumb key next to a key on the same hand (other finger).
items.name: Thumb rolls

items.desc: Trigrams with a thumb where every step into or out of the thumb changes hands.
items.name: Thumb alternates

items.desc: Chained stretches: both steps of a trigram have geometric stretch (stretch); their sum per 100 trigrams.
items.name: Contortions

items.desc: Both bigrams of the trigram are bad: same finger, lateral stretch (lsb) or a full/half scissor (scissor/half_scissor).
items.name: Irregular trigrams

items.desc: Bigram discomfort, mean of 1 − comfort, from Engram's hand-built pair formula (geometry `comfort.engram_formula`).
items.name: Engram formula

items.desc: Bigram discomfort, mean of 1 − comfort, fitted from Engram's pairwise choices (geometry `comfort.engram`).
items.name: Engram measured

items.desc: Predicted extra time per bigram, % of a median keystroke interval: a geometric model fitted to fast touch typists (Aalto 136M keystrokes). A judge; weight 0 in the bundled profiles.
items.name: Typing time

items.desc: The same key twice in a row.
items.name: Same-key repeats

items.desc: Layer-key presses per 100 bigrams: hold and toggle layers cost a press on entry, toggle layers another to leave, one-shot layers one per symbol; a press next to another key of the layer key's finger counts double. Plus Shift and Ctrl presses per 100 keystrokes (with a ⇧ / ⎈ key), double when the modifier's finger also types the key (Shift: or the key before).
items.name: Layer switches

items.desc: Code-symbol bigrams (`()`, `->`, `!=`, …) typed with one finger on two keys or across a layer change, as % of symbol bigrams.
items.name: Symbol bigrams

items.desc: Bracket pairs (`()`, `[]`, `{}`, `<>`) not adjacent or mirrored on one layer, weighted by use; reversed order counts half.
items.name: Paired symbols

items.desc: Same-hand rolls out of a home-row mod key (geometry `hrm`) onto another finger, where the hold can misfire.
items.name: HRM misfires

items.desc: Shortcut letters Z X C V (and A S Q W at half weight) away from the left hand: 100 off it, up to 50 on it by distance from the QWERTY spot. Per shortcut letter, not per keystroke.
items.name: Shortcut placement

items.desc: Distance from the reference layout (profile `familiar_to`), % of keystrokes: 0 on the reference key, 50 on another key of its finger, 75 on its hand, 100 otherwise.
items.name: Familiarity

items.desc: Vim motion keys h j k l against the profile's `vim` policy: row (one row, h j k l left to right on neighbouring keys), pairs (h left of l, j left of k, each on neighbouring keys) or fingers (four different fingers of one hand). % of the policy's key pairs broken; reversed neighbours count half. Weighted high it is a constraint.
items.name: Vim motions

items.desc: Related symbols (profile `sym_groups`, e.g. `+- */ != ^$`) not next to each other on one layer: neighbours on a row or a column of one hand, or mirrored on the other hand, in either order. % of the pairs on the layout, equal weights. Makes a layer learnable; weighted high it is a constraint.
items.name: Symbol groups

items.desc: Keys out of their zone: with profile `thumb_zone` (e.g. `␣⌫⏎`), a zone symbol off the base thumb keys or a letter, digit or punctuation symbol on one; with `base_letters`, a letter or zone symbol on a layer key. Weighted high it is a constraint (keysets use 100).
items.name: Key zones

profileToml:
name = "hand"
description = "Default plus the hand model: reach, press angle, wrist posture and thumb arc fit for an average hand (set [hand] to yours); effort halved since its key efforts also encode reach."
scale_basis = "stdev over 9 layouts (canary, colemak, colemak-dh, dvorak, graphite, halmak, semimak, sturdy, workman) on english / ansi-30"

# Target % per finger: LP LR LM LI LT RT RI RM RR RP
finger_target = [8.0, 11.0, 15.0, 16.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 15.0, 11.0, 8.0]

# `effort` added off the home row per finger (pinky ring middle index), [above, below] home.
# KLO's key costs: the top row is easy for middle/ring, the bottom row easy for index.
row_offset = [[0.0, 0.0], [-0.1, 0.1], [-0.2, 0.2], [0.2, -0.2]]

# Weights and scales: the default profile's (see data/profiles/default.toml for what they mean),
# plus the terms below.
# Hand for reach/wrist/press_angle/thumb_arc and stretch's relaxed spread: size = "small" | "average" | "large", or explicit
# [hand.dims] in mm (thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky segments; palm_width, palm_length, span,
# reach), as the web's Hand tab edits them. Optional [hand.body] elbow_width / forearm (mm) for
# wrist; default scaled with the hand (490 / 255 for average). context/hand-model.md.
[hand]
size = "average"

[weights]
sfb = 2.867            # SFB %; +17 % time per SFB pair (Aalto key-pair timing)
sfs = 0.03916          # SFS %, one key between; no timing or comfort cost found, kept near zero
sfs_far = 0.064        # far SFS %, 2–3 keys between (decayed); as sfs
stretch = 0.5046       # geometric stretch (LSB, scissors, crossings); +5 % time per stretch unit
movement = 0.08619     # finger-pair movement (KLO table + ring coupling); no timing effect
skip_stretch = 0.01843 # skip stretch (stretch on keys 1–3 of a trigram)
scissor = 0.09229      # full scissors; mostly carried by stretch and row_jump
half_scissor = 0.02398 # half scissors; no measurable timing effect
hand_switch = 1.003    # hand alternation (bigrams): −8 % time per alternating pair
pinky_ring = 1.176     # pinky–ring pairs: +8 % time
row_jump = 0.2852      # same-hand row jump: +4 % time per key of vertical travel
effort = 0.1603        # key effort, halved: reach carries reach, effort keeps finger strength
home_row = 0.03744     # home row share; no effect beyond effort
finger_target = 0.19   # finger load error (mean squared %)
hand_balance = 0.4181  # hand balance
alternate = 0.06432    # trigram alternates; no credit beyond hand_switch
inroll = 0.3051        # rolls in: faster third keystroke
outroll = 0.7151       # rolls out: −1.4 % third-keystroke time
redirect = 0.00602     # redirects; no measured cost beyond bad_redirect
bad_redirect = 0.5674  # bad redirects: +3.7 % third-keystroke time
engram = 2.08          # measured key-pair discomfort (Engram); the main comfort term
reach = 0.4272         # hand-model reach
press_angle = 0.3056   # hand-model press angle; mostly separates boards, mild on flat ones
wrist = 1.0            # wrist posture, NATURAL units (no scale): a board metric (ANSI 2.1, split 1.7,
              # tented 1.0); its spread over layouts on one board is ~0.002, so it barely moves search
thumb_arc = 1.0 # thumb arc fit, NATURAL units (no scale): 0 on ansi-30 (no thumbs), so it has no
              # spread there; per keystroke ≈ 0.2 between an on-arc and a 1 u off-arc space key

[scale]
sfb = 0.7908
sfs = 1.209
sfs_far = 0.4285
stretch = 1.316
movement = 18.14
skip_stretch = 1.341
scissor = 0.5297
half_scissor = 0.6859
hand_switch = 5.126

row_jump = 3.366
effort = 0.03799

engram: # Engram 2-key comfort scores mapped onto ansi-30 (row, col), 30x30 = 900 ordered pairs.
# scale: 0..1; direction: higher = more comfortable. score = engram_avg4 = mean(row_separation, same_row, same_finger, outside).
# key_preference (per-key Bradley-Terry tiers, mean of the two keys) is NOT part of score; it is listed for reference.
# Ordered pairs: a is typed first. a == b (same-key repeat) is scored as same finger by Engram.
# Cross-hand pairs are 1.0 on every transition criterion (score 1.0, or less only via outside).
# Mapping: QWERTY row r / col c on the 3x10 block -> ansi-30 row r, col c (row 0 top, col 0 left pinky).
